column1: mode    here     -  the nearest TODO.md, here or a parent up to ~           default
mode    all      -  every TODO.md: ghq's repositories, repositories under ~, dotbare's config directories (ctrl-r rescans)  -
toggle  done     alt-d  completed items too                               -
sort    urgency  -  open first, then overdue, priority, due date, file order  default
action  edit     ctrl-e  open the item in $EDITOR at its line             foreground,reload
action  done     ctrl-d  mark the item done                               silent,reload
action  paste    -       paste the lines into the tmux pane given by --paste  print
action  copy       ctrl-y  copy the titles                              silent,builtin
action  copy-line  alt-y   copy the lines (TODO.md:LINE ☐  (Pn) [category] Title)  silent,builtin
